title: Self-Healing Backend API Server, XAMPP Orchestration & Zero-Downtime Data Population Pipeline
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
The User logged into Candidate Workspace Overview (https://ime365.local / http://localhost) and discovered that data was not populated: 0 Active Resumes, Not Scored ATS, 0 Job Applications, and header displaying '✦ AI Engine Status Unknown'.
Investigation proved that the MariaDB database ('ai_resume_builder') actually contains 15 active resumes and complete user account data for this user (user_id: OhZdiSIFL7ePA1TMkfu9bnR935D3, email: bhaskar.beyond@gmail.com).
The root cause is that the Node.js Express API server (backend/index.js on port 8080) was completely down and never started by XAMPP or startup scripts. All /api/* requests failed with HTTP 502/404, and the frontend silently swallowed the error with catch(() => setResumes([])) masquerading as an empty account.
The User strictly demands: 'why is data not being populated? Is it because of APi server? I dont want to see this happening again. give best directive to developer'.
Mandate: Architect an enterprise-grade, self-healing, unified lifecycle for the Node.js API server under XAMPP policy, ensure Apache and PHP proxies cleanly route /api/*, add an active 5-second watchdog to auto-heal port 8080 crashes, and upgrade the frontend to gracefully handle and report API connectivity states.

### 2. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
1. RCA-1 (Unsupervised API Server on Port 8080): START_ResumePilotAI_Services.bat and bridge xampp start all only execute apache_start.bat (ports 80/443) and mysql_start.bat (port 3306). Neither process launched or monitored backend/index.js on port 8080.
2. RCA-2 (502 Bad Gateway via PHP Reverse Proxy): On https://ime365.local, Apache forwards /api/* to dist/api/index.php. The PHP script curls http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/*. When port 8080 is dead, curl fails with connection refused, returning 502 BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.
3. RCA-3 (Silent Frontend Error Swallowing): In CubaCandidateHero.jsx, getResumes().catch(() => setResumes([])) catches 502/network errors and silently defaults to an empty array. The user sees '0 Active Resumes' and fears data loss rather than seeing a server connectivity alert.
4. RCA-4 (Apache localhost VirtualHost Misalignment): In D:\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-vhosts.conf, the localhost virtualhost maps to D:/xampp/htdocs (which serves default XAMPP files and has no /api routing), returning 404 for any direct http://localhost/api/* call.
5. RCA-5 (Missing Port 8080 in Watchdog Daemon): lead_watcher_daemon.cjs actively monitors port 48200 and port 1234, but has zero health probing or self-healing for port 8080 (backend/index.js).

### 3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION & IMPLEMENTATION STEPS
- S1: 3-Tier XAMPP Service Lifecycle in bridge.cjs & Desktop BAT Scripts
  - Update xamppControl in C:\Users\mbhas\.ai-bridge\bridge.cjs:
    * xampp status: Report Apache (80/443), MySQL (3306), and Node.js Backend API Server (8080).
    * xampp start: Atomically launch Apache, MySQL, and start backend/index.js as a background managed process (saving PID to backend_api.pid and verifying http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz responds HTTP 200).
    * xampp stop: Gracefully drain connections on port 8080 (via SIGTERM/taskkill) alongside Apache and MySQL.
  - Update START_ResumePilotAI_Services.bat and STOP_ResumePilotAI_Services.bat to invoke bridge xampp start all and explicitly verify port 8080 readiness.
- S2: Port 8080 Autonomous Self-Healing in lead_watcher_daemon.cjs
  - Add active HTTP polling to lead_watcher_daemon.cjs targeting http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz or /api/service-availability every 5 seconds (2000ms timeout).
  - If port 8080 fails 3 consecutive probes or drops out:
    * Log the outage to lead_watcher_daemon.log.
    * Force-kill any lingering zombie process on port 8080.
    * Cleanly respawn node backend/index.js in < 5 seconds.
    * Enforce exponential backoff (5s -> 60s) and single-instance spawn mutex to prevent spawn loops.
- S3: Apache VirtualHost Alignment & Proxy Resilience
  - Update D:\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-vhosts.conf:
    * Ensure localhost VirtualHost has DocumentRoot "D:/xampp/htdocs/IME365/dist" with AllowOverride All (matching ime365.local).
    * Add native Apache proxy rules (ProxyPass /api http://127.0.0.1:8080/api and ProxyPassReverse /api http://127.0.0.1:8080/api) under <IfModule mod_proxy.c> so proxying is direct and ultra-fast.
- S4: Honest Frontend Error State & Auto-Reconnect in Candidate Portal
  - In CubaCandidateHero.jsx and dashboard data loaders:
    * Distinguish between HTTP 200 empty array (user truly has 0 resumes) vs HTTP 502/503/network error.
    * If the API server is unreachable, set apiError = true and display a sleek Cuba executive badge/banner: '✦ Connecting to API Server...' with automatic retry every 3-5 seconds.
    * Once reconnected, smoothly fetch and display the user's actual resumes and statistics without requiring a full page refresh.
- S5: End-to-End Resilience & Data Population Test Battery
  - Author tests/test_api_server_e2e_resilience.cjs:
    1. Assert port 8080 responds HTTP 200 on /healthz and /api/service-availability.
    2. Assert Apache responds HTTP 200 on http://localhost/api/service-availability and https://ime365.local/api/service-availability.
    3. Authenticate user OhZdiSIFL7ePA1TMkfu9bnR935D3 and assert /api/resumes returns 15 resumes.
    4. Simulate an unexpected termination (Stop-Process on node port 8080) and measure time until lead_watcher_daemon recovers the listener -> assert recovery time < 6000ms.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: Port 8080 (backend/index.js) is continuously running, managed via bridge xampp and protected by lead_watcher_daemon.cjs.
- AC-2: http://localhost/api/service-availability and https://ime365.local/api/service-availability both return HTTP 200 with { operational: true }.
- AC-3: Candidate Dashboard on both localhost and ime365.local populates the user's 15 real resumes and displays '✦ AI Engine Ready'.
- AC-4: If port 8080 is killed, the supervisor daemon auto-recovers it in < 6 seconds with zero user intervention.
- AC-5: Zero fake 0-data displays on frontend; connectivity errors are transparently presented and auto-recovered.
